subject: How to change the time zone of a shinyapp?

messages.author: e27f916765f79080
messages.subject: How to change the time zone of a shinyapp?
parts:
I have an app that fetches weather forecasts from forecast.io and the problem is that the shinyapp seems to operate on the GMT+0 time zone, whereas I would like to the times to be on the Finland time zone (GMT+2). How can I change this?

br, Juuso

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How to change the time zone of a shinyapp?
parts:
ShinyApps runs in UTC time. UTC times can be converted to any timezone using the at.POSIXct function:

as.POSIXlt(Sys.time(), "EET")

-Andy

Hi Andy!

Thanks! I actually managed to solve the problem by setting the system time zone to Finnish time with 'Sys.setenv(TZ="Europe/Helsinki")'. So either solution works.

br, Juuso
